# NovaBank workshop engineering contract

Read BUSINESS_CONTRACT.md before edits. Explain assumptions and then propose
the minimum change. Preserve signed decimal amounts, cancellation history,
left-join semantics, deterministic deduplication and the half-open day window.
Never modify data/expected, reference.py, or tests to make a candidate pass.
Run the reconciliation against labs/lab02/silver.sql and report actual output.
Do not claim SQL Server / Databricks execution or performance without evidence.
Genie Code does not automatically consume this GitHub-specific file: copy the
equivalent instructions from prompts/ into its chat or custom instructions.
